The new fallback wording closes the old dodge. For information: 4 gold in one trigger is over the proposed one-off cap (not approved)

line: Bargain prices well when the price is real; the Hob's +4/+4 gift is the one still over.

name: Pawn

units.name: Carrion Crow Fence
units.estimate: body 3 + pawning instead of selling gives 3 gold and +1 more on forfeit: +3 gold over a normal sale, paid around turns 3–5 (≈ 6; E54) [guess] ≈ 9 vs V(1) 5: +80%, ±25%; at the Tier-1 table ≈ 6.5 (+30%), still over
units.fix: Tier 2, same text (the gold arrives around turns 5–6, ≈ 5.4): ≈ 8.4 (+20%).

units.name: Jackdaw Pawnbroker
units.estimate: As the old review: one Pawn slot, ≈ one pawn every other turn for +2 over a sale ≈ +1 gold a turn ≈ 6 [guess] ≈ 11 vs V(2) 7: +57%, ±25%. The new rules already keep Created units out
units.fix: Tier 4 at 3/4, same text (+1 gold a turn at 4.2 × 0.8 ≈ 3.4): ≈ 10.4 (+4%).

units.name: Jackdaw Uncle
units.estimate: body 8 + +2/+2 per buy-back (once a turn: pawn, then buy back at once for a net 1 gold; net ≈ 4 − 2 = 2 SP × 0.6 Pawn on board: s ≈ 1.2; 3.1 × 1.2 ≈ 3.7; E88) [guess] ≈ 11.7 vs V(4) 10: +17%, ±25%. For information: each buy-back replays 'when played' text for 1 gold

line: Pawning is a better sale, which is gold, and gold at Tiers 1–2 is worth a lot, so the gold-makers sit better a tier or two higher.

name: Barter

units.name: Fox Cub Peddler
units.estimate: body 3 + a barter saves 2 gold against sell-and-buy (≈ 0.4 uses a turn on turns 1–5: ≈ 0.8 gold a turn × ≈ 5.5 early recurring price ≈ 4.5; E44) [guess] ≈ 7.5 vs V(1) 5: +50%, ±25%
units.fix: Barter costs 1 gold on this card (it still saves 1): ≈ 5.6 (+12%).

units.name: Rag-and-Bone Fox
units.estimate: Same as the old review: ≈ recurring +2 gold a turn + +1/+1 per barter (s = 2, over the Tier-3 cap) ≈ 23 vs V(3) 8: +188%, ±25%
units.fix: 'Barter (1 gold)' and drop the +1/+1, on 1/2 (≈ 8.1, +1%); the +1/+1 payoff can live on a Tier-5 fox.

units.name: Market Vixen
units.estimate: body 10 + Barter late (≈ 0.8 uses × 2 gold ≈ 1.6 gold a turn ≈ 5.8) + the new unit keeps the old one's permanent buffs (≈ 4 SP a use: s ≈ 3.2; 2.6 × 3.2 ≈ 8.3; E08) [guess] ≈ 24 vs V(5) 12: +100%, ±25%
units.fix: Drop its own Barter so it pays off other Barter units, on 3/6: 9 + 2.6 × 1.9 ≈ 14 (+17%). The text should say the unit given away loses those buffs, or buying it back duplicates them.

line: A free swap saves 2 gold every turn, so Barter needs a gold cost or a higher tier.

name: Aisle

units.name: Rent-Paying Vole
units.estimate: body 4 + +1/+1 permanently per aisle card bought (≈ 0.4 a turn early, more on refresh-heavy turns: s ≈ 0.8, at the Tier-1 cap; 3.9 × 0.8 ≈ 3.1) [guess] ≈ 7.1 vs V(1) 5: +42%, ±25%

units.name: Sett Landlord
units.estimate: Same as the old review: ≈ recurring +0.7 gold a turn from discounts (≈ 4.5) + body 7 ≈ 11.5 vs V(2) 7: +64%, ±25%
units.fix: Tier 3, 2/2, once per turn (≈ 7.6, −5%).

units.name: Market Hedgehog
units.estimate: Same as the old review: +2/+2 on the aisle card when bought (s ≈ 2: 3.1 × 2 ≈ 6.2) + body 7 ≈ 13.2 vs V(4) 10: +32%, ±25%
units.fix: 2/3 and once per turn (≈ 11.2, +12%).

line: Aisle text acts on every shop fill, so with no turn timer it needs once per turn and smaller bodies.

name: Cold Store

units.name: Red-Backed Shrike
units.estimate: body 4 + the stored card grows +1/+1 a turn until bought (s ≈ 2 × 0.85 ≈ 1.7, over the Tier-2 cap; 3.7 × 1.7 ≈ 6.3) − a shop slot ≈ 0.5 (E14 on one card) [guess] ≈ 9.8 vs V(2) 7: +40%, ±25%

units.name: Snow-Cache Wolverine
units.estimate: Now +2/+2 a turn: s ≈ 3.4, twice the Tier-3 cap; 3.5 × 3.4 ≈ 11.9 − 0.5 + body 7 [guess] ≈ 18.4 vs V(3) 8: +130%, ±25%

units.name: Ice-Cellar Stoat
units.estimate: body 8 + a Created plain copy per Cold Store buy (≈ 0.25 a turn × ≈ 7 SP, E43; card generation every turn priced as per-turn scaling, 3.1 × 1.75 ≈ 5.4), and the copy helps triples [guess] ≈ 13.4 vs V(4) 10: +34%, ±25%

line: A card that grows in the shop is per-turn scaling paid out on purchase, so it meets the same growth caps as a unit on the board.

name: Fast (action, N)

units.name: Still-Water Heron
units.estimate: Feast +4/+4 every 2 turns without a paid refresh, common early (≈ 0.55 of the time): s ≈ 2.2, over the Tier-2 cap of 1.3; 3.7 × 2.2 ≈ 8.1 − refreshes given up ≈ 0.7 + body 5 [guess] ≈ 12.4 vs V(2) 7: +77%, ±25%. The count now resets after each Feast, so the old quadratic growth is gone. Priced with Break Fast needing a count of 1 or more; at 0 it would be +2/+2 every turn
units.fix: Feast +2/+2 on 2/2 (≈ 7.4, +6%); Break Fast then gives +1/+1.

units.name: Lenten Heron
units.estimate: 8 free refreshes after 2 turns without refreshing; about 4 are useful on a normal turn (E52: 4 × 1.1 ≈ 4.4 a Feast, ≈ 0.67 gold-equivalent a turn ≈ 2.8) + body 8 [guess] ≈ 10.8 vs V(4) 10: +8%, ±25%. For information: 8 in one turn is a banked-turn case for the deferred turn-length check

units.name: Olm Sleeper
units.estimate: body 10 + a Feast turn of 2-gold units every 4 turns (≈ 6 gold saved on a banked turn ≈ +1.5 gold a turn ≈ 6) − 3 turns without buying units (≈ −4) [guess] ≈ 12 vs V(5) 12: 0%, ±25%; very uncertain, and 'half the Feast' has no clear meaning for a price change

line: With the count resetting after each Feast, Fast is a timed reward, not a runaway; the Tier-2 stat Feast is still too big.

name: Dig Down

units.name: Mole Prospector
units.estimate: body 5 + +1/+1 permanently per unit bought while dug down (≈ 1.5 buys × 0.6 a mole on board: s ≈ 1.8 once Tier-4 moles arrive; priced at turn 6, 3.1 × 1.8 ≈ 5.6) [guess] ≈ 10.6 vs V(2) 7: +51%, ±25%; ≈ 6.5 (−7%) before a mole is on board

units.name: Mole Foreman
units.estimate: As the old review: one free refresh a turn ≈ 2.1 + low-tier access ≈ 1.3 (any lower tier now) + body 8 [guess] ≈ 11.4 vs V(4) 10: +14%, ±25%

units.name: Deep-Seam Mole
units.estimate: body 10 + Dig Down ≈ 2.3 + units cost 2 while dug down (≈ 2 buys × 0.6 of turns ≈ 1.2 gold a turn × 4.1 ≈ 4.9; E53) [guess] ≈ 17.2 vs V(5) 12: +43%, ±25%

line: Dig Down itself is fair; a discount or growth on every dug-down buy adds up fast without a turn timer.

name: Hibernate (N)

units.name: Clockwork Dormouse
units.estimate: asleep ≈ 4 fights, then 7/7 from about turn 6; time-averaged over turns 2–12 ≈ 8.9 vs V(2) 7: +27% (old review: +20%), ±25% (E02 on proposed R34, E96) [guess]
units.fix: None yet; check in the sim. Bought with fewer than 2 upgrades left it never wakes, as intended.

units.name: Fat Dormouse
units.estimate: asleep ≈ 2 fights, then 6/6 from about turn 6: time-averaged ≈ 9 (+12%) + 'upgrades cost 1 less' on the upgrade it sleeps through (one-off gold at Tier 3 ≈ 4.5) [guess] ≈ 13.5 vs V(3) 8: +69%, ±25%
units.fix: Tier 4, same text: one-off gold is cheaper there (2.2) and it wakes about turn 8: ≈ 10.2 (+2%).

units.name: Dormouse Clockmaker
units.estimate: body 7 + +2/+2 permanently to ≈ 1.43 neighbours per wake (≈ 5.1 a wake × ≈ 1.5 wakes after turn 6 × 0.6 Hibernate build ≈ 4.6, one-off) [guess] ≈ 11.6 vs V(4) 10: +16%, ±25%

line: Sleeping units pay for their missing fights about right; a gold discount on the same upgrade tips the Tier-3 one over.

name: Rehearse

units.name: Den Dormouse
units.estimate: body 2 + +1/+1 a turn in hand, +2/+2 with another Rehearse card (≈ 0.3): s ≈ 2.6 × 0.6 for growth that isn't fighting: 3.7 × 2.6 × 0.6 ≈ 5.8 (E17, E02) [guess] ≈ 7.8 vs V(2) 7: +11%, ±25%. The old review: in band if held up to about 4 turns

units.name: Understudy Toad
units.estimate: Same as the old review: in-hand growth ≈ 4.2 + +1/+1 to other Bog folk per turn rehearsed, up to 4 (≈ 8.6) + body 4 ≈ 16.8 vs V(3) 8: +110%, ±25%
units.fix: 1/1, payoff '+1 Attack to your other Bog folk for each turn it rehearsed (up to 3)': ≈ 9.4 (+18%).

units.name: Old Sleeper
units.estimate: Same as the old review: ≈ 15.6 vs V(5) 12: +30%, ±25%; more when the pair doubling applies
units.fix: If the sim agrees, 3/3 (≈ 13.6, +13%).

line: Growth in hand is cheaper than growth on the board, but payoffs that multiply it by turns rehearsed run over.

name: Fly South

units.name: Swallow
units.estimate: misses 2 fights, returns as 4/3 for fights 3–6 (time-averaged body ≈ 4.7) + a Created random unit of your tier (E41: 0.55 × V(2) ≈ 3.9) [guess] ≈ 8.6 vs V(1) 5: +72%, ±25%

units.name: Stork Courier
units.estimate: misses fights 4–5, returns as 5/5 for fights to about turn 9 (time-averaged ≈ 6.7) + a random unit of your tier (0.45 × V(3–4) ≈ 4; E41, E96) [guess] ≈ 10.7 vs V(3) 8: +34%, ±25%. The old review put it in band; it didn't count the bundle at full value

units.name: Stork Postmaster
units.estimate: body 9 + +2/+2 permanently to the returner and its bundle (≈ 0.3 returns a turn × 8 × 0.9: s ≈ 2.2, under the cap; 2.6 × 2.2 ≈ 5.6) [guess] ≈ 14.6 vs V(5) 12: +22%, ±25%
units.fix: If the sim agrees, 4/4 (≈ 13.6, +13%).

line: A free unit card plus +2/+2 more than pays for two missed fights, so Fly South carriers want smaller bodies.

name: Mimic

units.name: Starling Echo
units.estimate: body 3, then one copy at turn 3 of a ≈ 6-SP enemy unit if the slot was filled (≈ 0.55): time-averaged over turns 2–6 ≈ 4.3 + triple help ≈ 0.2 (E31) [guess] ≈ 4.5 vs V(2) 7: −36%, ±25%. Bought late, it copies a much bigger unit
units.fix: Tier 1, same text (≈ 4.5 vs V(1) 5, −10%); sim late buys, when it copies a Tier-4–5 unit.

units.name: Jay Sentinel
units.estimate: body 6 + +1/+1 permanently per copy (≈ 1 a turn × 0.6 a Mimic on board: s ≈ 1.2; 3.5 × 1.2 ≈ 4.2) [guess] ≈ 10.2 vs V(3) 8: +28%, ±25%
units.fix: If the sim agrees, 2/3 (≈ 9.2, +15%).

units.name: Mocking Jay
units.estimate: Same as the old review: base copy of the unit across + its own +2/+2 × 0.9 ≈ 11.7 at turn 6 (+17%), ≈ 15.3 late (+53%), ±25%
units.fix: Drop 'Has +2/+2' (≈ 8.1 at turn 6, ≈ 11.7 late), or keep it and move it to Tier 5.

line: Mimic is worth whatever stands across, so it is weak early and strong late at every tier; price it by when it is bought.

name: Foundling

units.name: Swapped Babe
units.estimate: body 2 + saves about one buy when you hold a Tier-1–2 pair (E44 ≈ 4.3 × 0.5) + Fairy type ≈ 0.3 (E85) [guess] ≈ 4.5 vs V(1) 5: −10%, ±25%

units.name: Cradle Changeling
units.estimate: Same as the old review: body 4 + a saved buy (≈ 4 × 0.6) + Fairy type ≈ 0.3 ≈ 6.7 vs V(3) 8: −16%, ±25%

units.name: Fairy Ring Keeper
units.estimate: body 7 + Start of Combat +2/+2 to other Fairies (≈ 1.5 Fairies at the tribe rate × 4 SP × 0.9 ≈ 5.4; E01, T08) [guess] ≈ 12.4 vs V(4) 10: +24%, ±15%

line: Foundlings price like a saved buy and are in band; the Keeper is a standard tribe buffer on a full body.

name: Pair

units.name: Bewick's Swan
units.estimate: body 4 + a second copy bonds into a 4/4 that saves a slot (≈ 1 × 0.4; E23) ≈ 4.4 vs V(1) 5: −12%; bonded ≈ 9 vs two cards' 10 (−10%), ±15%

units.name: Mute Swan Paladin
units.estimate: Same as the old review: single ≈ 7.3 (+4%), bonded ≈ 15.6 vs 14 (+11%), ±15%. The new rule (golden takes the higher stats) removes the old four-times-body worry

units.name: Swan Maiden
units.estimate: back-bound: 2.25 + 5 = 7.25 + 'End of Turn: +1/+1 to the units in front' (power-budget example #7a: s ≈ 3.8, over the Tier-4 cap; 3.1 × 3.8 ≈ 11.8) ≈ 19 vs V(4) 10: +90%, ±25%; bonded it fires twice
units.fix: Power-budget example #7b: 1/3, 'give the units in front of this +1 Health permanently' (≈ 9.65, −4%); bonded ≈ 18.3 vs two cards' 20.

line: Pair prices fine; the Maiden is the budget's own failing example, and its passing twin is the fix.

name: Brew

units.name: Herb-Wife Newt
units.estimate: body 4 + merging two bought spells moves no stats (one fewer cast, one hand slot freed ≈ 0.2) [guess] ≈ 4.2 vs V(1) 5: −16%, inside the ±1 SP floor

units.name: Toadstone Apothecary
units.estimate: Same as the old review: body 6 + +2/+2 per Strong cast (≈ 0.3 a turn: s ≈ 1.2; 3.5 × 1.2 ≈ 4.2) ≈ 10.2 vs V(3) 8: +28%, ±25%
units.fix: If the sim agrees, 2/3 (≈ 9.2, +15%).

units.name: Cauldron Toad
units.estimate: body 10 + Brew ≈ 0.2 + every refresh offers a copy of the spell in hand (spell shop control, E60: the best-rate spell every time ≈ 3.5) [guess] ≈ 13.7 vs V(5) 12: +14%, ±25%. For information: with a free-refresh spell, each refresh offers it again; the proposed guardrails G5 and G12 (not approved) cover that

line: Brew adds no stats, so its cards are bodies plus payoffs; the Cauldron Toad's spell copying is the one to watch for loops.

name: Endangered

units.name: Corncrake
units.estimate: body 4 + +1/+1 per copy out of the pool (≈ 3 mid-game: yours, other boards and shops) ≈ 6 (E09) [guess] ≈ 10 vs V(2) 7: +43%, ±25%; if async counts only your own game, ≈ 6.4 (−9%)

units.name: Grouse Lek
units.estimate: body 8 + your Endangered units also count each other's copies (≈ +3/+3 on ≈ 1.5 Endangered units × 0.6 ≈ 5.4) [guess] ≈ 13.4 vs V(4) 10: +34%, ±25%

units.name: Last Capercaillie
units.estimate: Same as the old review: +3/+3 to +4/+4 ≈ 14–16 vs V(5) 12: +17% to +33%, ±25%
units.fix: If the sim agrees, 3/3 (≈ 12–14).

line: Every Endangered price depends on how many copies leave the pool, which the async model (rulebook 2.1.5) hasn't settled.

name: Rainbow

units.name: Rainbow Sprite
units.estimate: body 4 + a Pot that grows 1 gold a turn to 10, claimed once after 2 wins: about recurring +1 gold for the game, paid in one lump (6.5 × 0.7 ≈ 4.5; E50) [guess] ≈ 8.5 vs V(2) 7: +21%, ±25%. The Pot stays if the Sprite is sold. For information: up to 10 gold in one claim is over the proposed one-off cap (not approved)
units.fix: If the bot agrees, 2/1 (≈ 7.5, +7%).

units.name: Cluricaun
units.estimate: body 7 + a Pot from turn 6 (≈ 7 gold by turn 12: 4.2 × 0.7 × 0.6 the task is met ≈ 1.8) [guess] ≈ 8.8 vs V(4) 10: −12%, ±25%

units.name: Gold-Digger Brownie
units.estimate: body 6 + +1 Attack per 2 gold to every Fairy when a Pot is claimed (a 6–10 gold Pot gives +3 to +5 Attack × ≈ 2.5 Fairies × 0.9 ≈ 8, once per Pot × 0.6 ≈ 4.8; E01) [guess] ≈ 10.8 vs V(3) 8: +35%, ±15%

line: The Pot is about a slow +1 gold a turn and prices near the band; the Brownie's team-wide payoff makes waiting for a full Pot very strong.

name: Offstage

units.name: Prompter Mouse
units.estimate: never takes a board slot: Start of Combat +2 Attack to F1 (≈ 2.2) + a slot saved ≈ 1 (E23, proposed E96) [guess] ≈ 3.2 vs V(1) 5: −36%, ±15%
units.fix: '+2/+2' instead of '+2 Attack' (≈ 5.2, +4%).

units.name: Wings Toad
units.estimate: +1 Attack this combat to other Bog folk per Bog folk death (≈ 3 buffs a fight × 0.6 realised ≈ 1.8) + a slot saved ≈ 1 [guess] ≈ 2.8 vs V(3) 8: −65%, ±15%; played as a 2/3 it is 5 (−38%)
units.fix: '+2/+2 this combat' instead of '+1 Attack' (≈ 8.2, +3%).

units.name: Stage Manager Fox
units.estimate: body 8 + +2/+2 to the Offstage card in hand, which counts only if that card is later played (≈ 0.6 × 0.3 × 3.6 ≈ 0.6) [guess] ≈ 8.6 vs V(4) 10: −14%, ±15%

line: An Offstage card gives only its effect, so the effect must carry most of a unit's budget; both are written at aura size and come out under. Slot-free value is a guess until simulated.
